title: NFRI stress test catalogue
note: Each scenario perturbs the scored universe and re-runs harness/scoring.py. Pass criteria encode industry testing norms: Lloyd's RDS (correlation), Solvency II (capital adequacy), value-chain placement/bundling structure, pricing discipline.

scenarios.name: Lloyd's RDS — single-constraint correlated curtailment
scenarios.industry_standard: Lloyd's Realistic Disaster Scenarios — portfolio-wide correlated loss
scenarios.description: Simulates one grid constraint event hitting all non-firm assets and clustered books simultaneously (South Wales / East of England cluster).

pass_criteria.note: Under correlated stress, the index must surface Exposed entities; earning-it share may stay elevated for well-capitalised carriers (value-chain bundling: balance sheet separate from exposure).

scenarios.name: MGA paper withdrawal (reinsurer pulls capacity)
scenarios.industry_standard: MGA stress — loss of binding/reinsurance paper mid-year
scenarios.description: Value-chain note: MGAs lose paper when underwriting turns or broker relationship breaks. Stress L2 MGAs' capital_reinsurance.

pass_criteria.note: Specialist MGA (Parametrix) must retain MoS advantage over generalist carrier (Chubb) despite capital stress — product_fit and data_monitoring compensate.

scenarios.name: Broker facility at capacity (Nimbus-style)
scenarios.industry_standard: Delegated authority / binder — premium cap reached, no new risk absorbed
scenarios.description: When a facility is full, brokers cannot write new DC risk; book concentration spikes but preparedness does not.

pass_criteria.note: Brokers under capacity stress must not appear Earning-it without matching preparedness (product_fit + expertise).

scenarios.name: Parametric/indemnity basis mismatch under curtailment
scenarios.industry_standard: Basis risk stress — index trigger vs true SLA loss (European Actuarial Journal)
scenarios.description: Curtailment causes SLA losses but physical-damage BI does not respond; widen trigger_gap for traditional carriers.

pass_criteria.note: Parametrix (trigger_gap=0 by design) must beat median L1 MoS when carriers widen basis gap.

scenarios.name: Connections Reform — Gate 1 flood (CMP434/CMP448)
scenarios.description: All L3 assets shift to maximum non-firm intensity from register shock (queue reform).

pass_criteria.note: High-load constrained-region assets must land Exposed under firmness shock (≥1 L3; Kao or Latos if in universe).

scenarios.name: Amazon-scale shared & layered placement (60+ markets)
scenarios.industry_standard: Shared and layered — WTW/Amazon property tower; data-centres often sub-split
scenarios.description: Lead carrier with 60-follow market structure maximises aggregation on large DC writers.

pass_criteria.note: High-concentration DC construction writer (Zurich) must show lower MoS than whitespace specialist (Beazley) under tower stress.

scenarios.name: Broker chain structure (retail → wholesale → London)
scenarios.industry_standard: Structural invariant — brokers price/distribute; carriers hold balance sheet
scenarios.description: No code perturbation. Validates layer-appropriate sub-factor ordering from cannibal/broking essays.

scenarios.name: Strata pricing — latent vs disclosed divergence
scenarios.industry_standard: Import human-baseline claims history; do not invent priors
scenarios.description: Where latent rating exceeds deterministic by ≥2 points, fusion must not fully adopt latent (λ caps effective rating).

scenarios.name: Solvency II SCR breach stress
scenarios.description: Simulate SCR ratio collapse on carriers; preparedness must reflect capital stress.

pass_criteria.note: Disclosed SCR<100% must map to capital rating ≤2 and reduce MoS.
